scope: SECTIONMANAGER and SECTIONSETTINGS DXF object-record identity remapping, reservation and source-object binding.

source_context.schema: Autodesk defines DXF group 5 as the record handle and group 330 as the common soft-pointer owner field. Section body references use their distinct documented roles from the manager and section-type tables.
source_context.implementation_gap: Before this slice, dxfRW::writeSection emitted DRW_Section::handle verbatim while its owner and body references could be remapped, allowing a body pointer to name a different output identity than the corresponding record.

implementation.behavior: A supplied source group-5 identity is passed through remapObjectHandle, checked against zero/NoHandle/fixed IDs, reserved, written, and bound with bindDxfWriteSourceObjectHandle after successful output. A no-source record receives an allocated output identity. RecordStateScope and DxfWriterRecordScope keep identity state and bytes transactional.
implementation.reference_policy: The configured reference resolver continues to apply to owner and body references; it does not replace the source-handle remap policy for the record's own identity.
implementation.failure_behavior: Reservation, body-reference, owner, late-write, or source-binding failures roll back the record and scoped writer state.

validation.input: Generated in-memory records only; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.
controls: SECTIONMANAGER source identity remaps to group 5 while owner and repeated list references retain their own mappings
SECTIONSETTINGS source identity remaps to group 5 while common owner, nested source pointers and destination pointer retain their own mappings
resolver precedence on reference edges does not override the record-identity mapping
no-source SECTION record allocates an output identity through the corrected fresh-writer retry path
existing unresolved-reference and malformed-list atomicity controls still pass

qualification_limits: Generated controls do not establish that source-required Section objects are all present or have valid owners.
No physical producer, independent native consumer, or section-generation semantic result was used.
This identity fix does not promote SECTIONMANAGER or SECTIONSETTINGS support claims.
